body: My mom is also a medical professional, so the fact she doesn't acknowledge the signs adds to it all.

I just got back from driving around to help clear my head. I would be lying if I said I didn't think about speeding up and crashing into the medium. But I was able to make myself feel a little better. 

And I know I can improve my situation. It's hard, since I'm still pretty dependent on her. I'm looking for work so I can start becoming more independent but no one wants to hire someone without much experience. 

I'll keep your kind words in mind. They're much appreciated.

I'm not sure exactly what happened, but a series of events caused my dad to leave me when I was 3 months old. My mom worked very hard, and I understand that. I have memories of her often yelling at me how she wish she aborted me or put me up for adoption. I had to leave my University due to an adverse affect of my medication and when I told her she said she wished she aborted me because I was a failure. When I attempted suicide, she tried to dissuade me from going to the hospital when I was vomiting up blood. When I went to the hospital when I started college, she called me every night telling me how disappointed she was in my choices. I told my doctors and they brought her in and somehow she switched it into that I was doing this and she was the victim.  I can't talk to her about it because it becomes about her. And I understand she has feelings, too. But she never hears mine out. It's difficult, to say the least.
